description: The line plot illustrates the variation in Attack Success Rate (ASR) across eight categorical labels—'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics'—under a clean-label poisoning scenario with a 10% poison rate (2.5% of total data) on the AGNews dataset. The x-axis is categorical, with no numerical units or scale, displaying the category names in order. The y-axis, labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Three distinct lines are plotted: the green “start” line, marked with circles and a solid style, begins at approximately 0.77 at 'cf', drops sharply to 0.49 at 'bb', rises steeply to 0.90 at 'WNBA', fluctuates slightly through 'ESPN' (0.82), 'NHL' (0.84), 'FIFA' (0.81), peaks at 0.95 at 'Estadio', and ends at 0.92 at 'athletics'. The orange “random” line, marked with x’s and a dashed style, starts at 0.66 at 'cf', falls to 0.50 at 'bb', climbs to 0.88 at 'WNBA', dips to 0.72 at 'ESPN', rises to 0.77 at 'NHL', peaks at 0.88 at 'FIFA', reaches 0.93 at 'Estadio', and ends at 0.86 at 'athletics'. The purple “end” line, marked with circles and a solid style, begins at 0.75 at 'cf', drops to 0.58 at 'bb', rises to 0.88 at 'WNBA', dips to 0.75 at 'ESPN', climbs to 0.89 at 'NHL', falls to 0.81 at 'FIFA', peaks at 0.97 at 'Estadio', and ends at 0.83 at 'athletics'. The “end” line generally remains above the “random” line across all categories except at 'bb', where both converge near 0.50. A legend in the bottom-right corner identifies the three lines by color, marker, and label.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates how ASR values vary across different categories under a clean-label scenario with a 10% poison rate in the AGNews dataset. The x-axis represents different categories labeled as 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics', with categorical spacing and no units. The y-axis, labeled 'ASR', has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick interval of 0.1. Three lines are depicted: a green line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'start', beginning around 0.8 at 'cf', sharply declining to 0.5 at 'bb', then peaking at approximately 0.9 at 'WNBA' and ending at 0.92 at 'athletics'; an orange line with x-shaped markers and a dashed line style labeled 'random', starting near 0.65 at 'cf', sharply declining to 0.5 at 'bb', peaking at approximately 0.88 at 'WNBA', and ending at 0.85 at 'athletics'; a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'end', starting around 0.75 at 'cf', showing peaks and troughs, and sharply declining to 0.58 at 'bb', then increasing steadily to end at approximately 0.9 at 'athletics'. The 'end' line consistently exceeds the 'random' line across all categories except 'bb', where both lines converge. A legend is given at the bottom right.
